attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file Indiana corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus (post-Wayfair).

initial_action.action_postfix: "Indiana Corporate Filing Requirement Check Started" job.audit_trail swap addto false result.in_has_nexus xdef

condition_details.condition_comment: Meets economic nexus threshold ($100K gross receipts, no transaction count as of Jan 1, 2024); result.in_gross_receipts is greater than or equal to result.in_economic_nexus_threshold

action_details.action_postfix: // No nexus - no filing required false result.in_has_nexus xdef 0.0 result.in_tax_liability xdef "Indiana filing not required: No nexus with state" job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Indiana state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income. IN requires addback of out-of-state municipal bond interest acquired after 12/31/2011.

initial_action.action_postfix: "Indiana Corporate Income Adjustments Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 result.in_state_additions xdef 0.0 result.in_state_subtractions xdef

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Indiana state additions and subtractions; Calculate state-specific income adjustments

action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 result.in_state_additions xdef 0.0 result.in_state_subtractions xdef "Indiana adjustments not calculated: No nexus" job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Indiana corporate income tax. Applies Indiana flat rate (4.9%) to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

initial_action.action_postfix: "Indiana Corporate Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 result.in_taxable_income xdef 0.0 result.in_tax_liability xdef

condition_details.condition_comment: Has positive taxable income; result.in_apportioned_income is greater than 0

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Indiana corporate tax (flat rate 4.9%); Apply Indiana 4.9% flat rate
No taxable income - no tax liability
action_details.action_postfix: // No taxable income - no tax liability 0.0 result.in_taxable_income xdef 0.0 result.in_tax_liability xdef result.in_estimated_payments result.in_refund_or_owed xdef "Indiana tax liability: $0 (no taxable income)" job.audit_trail swap addto
